notes.title: Add a Discord Server on Start Screen
notes.content:
Hello everyone!!!

Thanks for the support on my new horror game The Jester.

Now we have a [b]Discord Server[/b]. There we will be able to communicate and keep you informed about my new game releases and more!

Join in my [url=https://discord.com/invite/UfEE6YMBdH]Discord Server [/url]
